Sam: Quick idea: 'Recognition Roadshow' — small pop-up booths to hand out micro-spot kits and collect a 1-question pulse. Need volunteers, packing owner, and a simple tracking CSV. Thoughts? :tada:
Evelyn: Nice. Which offices + counts?
Sam: Proposed: SF (2 days, 140/day), NYC (1 day, 130), Dublin (1 day, 90), remote batch ~360. Total ~860 incl buffer.
Noah: I can lead SF days. Suggest manager-only setup first 30m, then open volunteer slots.
Priya: I'll build signup form with role dropdown (greeter, packer, ship-run) and a checkbox for "happy to do remote mail runs".
ops_bot: FYI: international shipments under $45 may avoid VAT in IE. See shipping-guidelines: https://redwood-internal/people-ops/shipping-guidelines
Evelyn: Kit contents? any cash-equivalents?
Sam: Kit = handwritten note, enamel pin, compostable sticker, QR card linking to tiny.redwood/roadshow?o=SF. No cash items by default. Any redemption > $150 goes through payroll.
Noah: I'll own inventory sheet. Will include: SKU, qty ordered, qty received, bin, packer initials, ship date, tax-review flag (auto if unit > 150), and export-ready CSV tab for shipping.
Priya: Volunteer windows: 09:00-11:00, 11:30-14:00, 15:00-17:00. I'll add accessibility notes and an "I need a quiet spot" checkbox on the form.
Evelyn: Procurement rec: try ParcelWave or GreenBox for eco packaging. I'll request quotes for 360 remote drops.
Sam: Comms: short blurb + Slack banner one week prior per office, and a 3-bullet post-event recap for All Hands. Priya can you draft blurb?
Priya: Yup — draft by Thursday. Also linking inventory: https://docs.redwood/roadshow/inventory (WIP).
Noah: Quick logistics: desk-drop requests allowed only with manager approval; I'll add a manager approval column.
ops_bot: Reminder: items that are cash-equivalent must be routed via payroll. Auto-flag rule applied. See payroll/gift-tax: https://redwood-internal/payroll/gift-tax
Sam: Great. Next steps: Priya finalizes signup + blurb Thu, Evelyn gets vendor quotes Tue, Noah finishes inventory by Wed. Quick check-in at next standup. :raised_hands:
